distinctions.FLAT_SIGNAL: machine-degenerate exact constancy over the window or a >= 400 ms advancing exact-equal span
distinctions.LARGE_GAP: source-update interval exceeds the inherited M-N4 bound
distinctions.NUMERIC_PLATEAU: accepted advancing source samples happen to share equal numeric values; not freeze by itself
distinctions.SOURCE_FREEZE: source event fails to advance for >= 400 ms while transport continues
distinctions.SOURCE_REPUBLICATION: short Q1 reuse of a previous source sample; core max run 1; not automatically unavailable
distinctions.STALE_SOURCE: phase_age_ms at or above 400 ms, or production freshness missing
